_doc: Figure types that belong to this atlas. tools/mkatlas.py merges them into data/widgets.json on refresh. They are implemented in assets/js/widgets/quant.js. Every figure is a toy or a sampling diagram, not a price forecast.

equity.title: Equity and drawdown
equity.desc: A toy price path you can drag, with the compounded equity index and the drawdown. Preset compare shows two orders of the same four returns.
equity.zh_desc: 可拖动的示意价格路径，以及复利净值与回撤。compare 预设用同一组四个收益率的两种顺序作比较。

preset.desc: a Path A, b Path B, c and d the two orders in the drawdown proof, compare draws c and d together

compound.title: Two-step compounding
compound.desc: Two simple returns, the sum, the compound growth, and the sum of the log returns.
compound.zh_desc: 两个简单收益率，以及它们的和、复利增长与对数收益率之和。

candles.title: OHLC bars
candles.desc: Toy open-high-low-close bars. The group size merges consecutive sessions into one bar.
candles.zh_desc: 示意的开高低收。分组大小把连续的时段合并成一根 K 线。

average.title: Two moving averages
average.desc: A fast and a slow average on one wavy toy path. Shading marks where the fast average is above the slow one.
average.zh_desc: 一条波动的示意路径上的快慢两条平均线。阴影表示快线在慢线之上的日期。

bands.title: Rolling band
bands.desc: A rolling mean and a band of k sample standard deviations on a toy mean-reverting path.
bands.zh_desc: 示意的均值回归路径上的滚动均值，以及 k 倍样本标准差的通道。

barlimit.title: Limit on a bar
barlimit.desc: Drag a limit across eight toy bars. Under the optimistic range convention the bar fills only when the limit lies between its low and its high.
barlimit.zh_desc: 在八根示意 K 线上拖动限价。在乐观的价格区间约定下，只有限价落在最低价与最高价之间才成交。

stop.title: Stop on one bar
stop.zh: 止损与单根 K 线
stop.desc: One toy bar and the chapter’s stop-market and stop-limit rules, including a gap through the trigger.
stop.zh_desc: 一根示意 K 线，以及本章的止损市价与止损限价规则，包括跳空穿过触发价的情形。
stop.example:
open: 90
high: 94
low: 88
close: 91
trigger: 95
limit: 93
kind: sell-market

folds.title: Walk-forward windows
folds.desc: Rolling or expanding train and test windows on one line of dates, with an optional label purge and embargo.
folds.zh_desc: 同一条日期上的滚动或扩展训练窗与测试窗，可加标签清洗和禁运。

h.desc: label horizon purged before each test

folds.example:
T: 30
L: 12
H: 6
S: 6
h: 0
m: 0
mode: rolling

weights.title: Inverse-volatility weights
weights.desc: Weights proportional to 1/σ, and the scale that takes the zero-correlation book to a volatility target.
weights.zh_desc: 与 1/σ 成比例的权重，以及把零相关组合波动率调到目标所需的比例。

sharpe.title: Sharpe and its standard error
sharpe.desc: A per-step Sharpe ratio and the Lo 2002 iid-normal standard error. Annualising multiplies both by √252.
sharpe.zh_desc: 逐步夏普比率，以及 Lo 2002 在独立同分布正态假设下的标准误。年化会把两者都乘以 √252。
sharpe.example:
mean: 0.01393
sd: 0.022848
n: 7
rf: 0
annualise: false

payoff.title: Win rate and profit factor
payoff.desc: Path A’s printed simple returns, or a win rate with an average win and an average loss. The profit factor is gains over absolute losses.
payoff.zh_desc: 路径 A 印出的简单收益率，或由胜率、平均盈利与平均亏损算出的盈亏比。盈亏比是盈利合计除以亏损绝对值合计。

spread.title: Hedge ratio and spread
spread.desc: Two invented series. The spread is the second minus a hedge ratio times the first. Its scatter is smallest near the ratio used to build the pair.
spread.zh_desc: 两条虚构序列。价差是第二条减去对冲比率乘以第一条。离散程度在构造这对序列所用的比率附近最小。

formation.title: Formation and skip
formation.desc: A formation window and a skip on a toy path. The signal is the simple return across the formation window only.
formation.zh_desc: 示意路径上的形成期与跳过区间。信号只用来自形成期的简单收益率。
